page_title: REN 3-1 REI | Rennes v Reims 26/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Ruddy Buquet has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Teddy Teuma (Reims) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Julien Stephan has decided to make a change. Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) replaces Arnaud Kalimuendo.
89' Teddy Teuma (Reims) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
88' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
87' Substitution. Adama Bojang (Reims) on for Mohamed Daramy.
85' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
83' Here is a change. Adrien Truffert is going off and Julien Stephan gives the last tactical orders to Ibrahim Salah (Rennes).
83' That will be all from Amine Gouiri who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes).
79' Reims control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
79' Junya Ito (Reims) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
77' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thomas Foket departs the field of play to be replaced by Reda Khadra (Reims).
76' Substitution. Oumar Diakite makes way for Amine Salama (Reims).
72' We are about to witness a substitution. Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) is replacing Benjamin Bourigeaud.
72' Julien Stephan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ludovic Blas (Rennes) replacing Martin Terrier.
70' Nemanja Matic (Rennes) picks up a yellow card.

66' 3 - 1 GOAL! Benjamin Bourigeaud curls the free kick into the box. Arthur Theate (Rennes) peels off his marker and arrows a brilliant header past Yehvann Diouf and into the right side of the net. 3:1.
63' A lofted pass into the box is met by Oumar Diakite (Reims), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
61' Junya Ito (Reims) launches a cross from the corner, but Steve Mandanda is alert to thwart the effort.
61' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Reims have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Junya Ito (Reims) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
58' Rennes are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
54' Amir Richardson (Reims) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Ruddy Buquet signals.
52' The linesman raises his flag. Oumar Diakite (Reims) is adjudged offside.
51' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
50' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
48' The Reims players are exchanging some short passes.
46' 2 - 1 Goal! Martin Terrier plays a simple square pass into the feet of Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Ruddy Buquet sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+3' Wait! Referee Ruddy Buquet has indicated he is going to review the Reims goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

45+1' 1 - 1 Goal! Junya Ito plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Oumar Diakite (Reims), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 1:1.
45+1' Reims quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

45+1' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Reims will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Neat passing move from Rennes in order to create new attacking opportunities.

43' The rebound finds Mohamed Daramy (Reims) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the left post. That was a promising chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
43' Thibault De Smet (Reims) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
42' Teddy Teuma (Reims) takes the corner which is cleared.
40' It's a throw-in for Rennes.
38' The Reims players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
36' The fouls committed statistics – 5:4.

34' What a wasted chance that is! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Christopher Wooh (Rennes) who sends his header well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Reims will have a goal kick.
33' William Still is forced to make a change. Marshall Munetsi (Reims) is unable to continue due to injury, Amir Richardson comes on.
33' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
31' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Rennes.
30' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
28' Teddy Teuma (Reims) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Ruddy Buquet blows his whistle for a foul.

26' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
23' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:3.
22' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Junya Ito (Reims) takes it short.
21' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Reims can continue in their attacking effort.
19' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' Thibault De Smet (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
16' The corner from Teddy Teuma (Reims) is intercepted by Steve Mandanda.

16' Marshall Munetsi (Reims) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Reims have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
15' Amine Gouiri (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but Yehvann Diouf comes off his line to gather the ball.
14' Thomas Foket (Reims) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
13' Rennes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

9' A neat pass is well received by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
9' The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.
8' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
6' Reims seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Amine Gouiri (Rennes) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
3' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
2' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Reims will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Ruddy Buquet.
